name: Explain fictional character actions and canon details
description: Users asked for explanations of specific plot points, character motivations, and behavioral logic within established fictional canons. The requests frequently involved analyzing why characters acted in certain ways, interpreting dialogue or symbolism, and identifying traits such as political ideologies or psychological patterns, rather than engaging in hypothetical 'what if' scenarios or creative roleplay.
